role: Adds hills and mutated (id+128) variants inside biomes, driven by a second input: the zoomed river-init noise decides mutation, and a 1 in 3 roll plus three matching neighbours decides hills.
scope_reason: Part of the overworld biome layer stack (GenLayer.initializeAllBiomeGenerators) that decides the biome of every overworld column.

members.name: logger
members.note: Debug log for ids above 255 only.

members.name: field_151628_d
members.note: struct layer p2; per layers_init its world seed stays 0 as in Java (hills does not seed its second input).

notes: layers.c builds the stack as a pointer graph of struct layer nodes (p1, p2) in a fixed 64-node array and recurses through it, and each layer mallocs its parent area per call (area()); both are GPU-contract hazards but outside the tick (chunk generation). Status exact rests on test_worldgen comparing the genbiomes and biomes stages against the oracle chunk dumps; the gate was not re-run for this record.
